summary_md:
# Marknaden tror på Fed-höjning – Svolder höjer utdelningen

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-09-16  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon talks through a quiet market waiting for the Fed. Rates are expected to rise 25bp, the US 10-year yield is at 4.99% and oil is near record levels. Most of the episode covers investment companies, including Svolder's Q4 report, discounts versus premiums and share buybacks, then moves to healthcare: medtech gets a small lift from Thermo Fisher's comments, while the guest sees a murky outlook for big pharma because of patent expiries, Chinese competition and R&D moving to the US. Guest Peter Lindvall (Cavalier) is bottom-up and says small caps look cheap, and he names Latour, Lync, Revolution Race, NewWave, Bone Support and Xvivo as holdings or preferred picks.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 SVOL-B — Svolder | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Q4 beat its benchmark, NAV +7%, dividend raised; ~3% discount; small caps at low valuations

#### Reasoning

The guest (Lindvall) likes that Svolder beat its benchmark and argues small caps are cheap (often 10x earnings). He does not recommend the stock outright. It trades near NAV, so there is little discount to capture.

#### Sell Triggers

- if small-cap interest keeps failing to return
- if it keeps underperforming the broad index

> *"Det är kul att de presterar bättre än sitt jämförelseindex"*

---

### 🟢 LATO-B — Latour | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Cavalier bought Latour back after selling at a ~90% premium; now the largest holding in its investment company fund

#### Reasoning

The guest manager trades investment companies on discount and premium. He sold Latour at an extreme premium and bought back once it normalised, so it is now his biggest position, which shows conviction at current valuation levels.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the premium balloons again toward 90%
- if NAV growth disappoints

> *"Nu har vi köpt tillbaka Latour, så det är vårt största innehav i investmentbolagsfonden."*

---

### 🟢 LYNC — Lync | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Went from a near-100% premium at IPO to a discount; guest says it is a very good company for life science exposure

#### Reasoning

Lindvall recommends Lync over picking hard-to-judge small research companies himself. The move from a large premium to a discount improves the entry point.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the discount turns into a large premium again
- if portfolio companies fail

> *"just för Link är väl ett väldigt bra bolag att köpa istället för att välja de här mindre bolagen"*

---

### 🟡 INVE-B — Investor | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Outstanding long-term record, but Cavalier trimmed because it now trades at a premium

#### Reasoning

The hosts praise Investor's compounding and its record against Berkshire. The guest has cut both Investor and Industrivärden because they moved from discounts to small premiums, so the quality is good but the valuation has become less attractive.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the premium widens further

> *"Vi har också minskat i Industrivärden, Investor, som historiskt har handlats med rabatter. Nu är det små premier."*

---

### 🟢 RVRC — Revolution Race | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Cavalier holding; taking market share in a weak German market; long growth runway

#### Reasoning

The guest holds it and looks past quarterly swings. Broader collections and new markets give long-term growth potential.

#### Sell Triggers

- if market share gains in Germany reverse
- if expansion into new markets stalls

> *"I Revolution Races fall tänker jag att det finns så mycket de kan växa på på längre sikt"*

---

### 🟡 NEWA-B — New Wave | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Long-time holder expects margins to improve in H2 2027 after the US warehouse build-out

#### Reasoning

The share is weak during the investment phase, but the guest and a host expect a re-rating once the investments are done and focus shifts back to sales.

#### Sell Triggers

- if margins do not improve by H2 2027
- if the US warehouse investment overruns

> *"Jag tror att vi får se en lönsamhetsförbättring under andra halvan 2027."*

---

### 🟢 BONE — Bone Support | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Held in Cavalier's focus fund; fast-growing with big opportunities

#### Reasoning

The guest named it as a top healthcare opportunity because of its fast growth.

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth slows markedly

> *"vi har ju Bone Support och Xvibo. Det är två snabbväxande bolag."*

---

### 🟢 XVIVO — Xvivo | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Held in Cavalier's focus fund; fast-growing with big opportunities

#### Reasoning

The guest named it alongside Bone Support as a fast grower with large potential.

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth slows markedly

> *"Där känns det som att det finns stora möjligheter för båda de bolagen."*

---

### 🟠 SOBI — Sobi | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Guest prefers niche pharma while the big-pharma outlook is murky

#### Reasoning

Patent expiries, rising R&D costs and US/China pressure cloud the large pharma companies. The guest suggests niche names like Sobi as more interesting.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the niche portfolio faces patent or competitive pressure

> *"så tror jag mer på lite mer nischade bolag. Det skulle Sobi kunna vara."*

---

### 🟠 ORNBV — Orion | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Finnish pharma with very little US exposure and a diversified business

#### Reasoning

Suggested as a way to avoid US policy risk in pharma.

#### Sell Triggers

- if US policy risk fades and the diversification premium no longer matters

> *"vi har finska Orions som har väldigt lite USA-exponering"*

---

### 🟠 BIOA-B — BioArctic | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

More approvals (Japan subcutaneous) validate the treatment; a small plus

#### Reasoning

Each new approval eases the benefit-versus-risk debate. The guest calls it a small step in the right direction, and the shares have already done well.

#### Sell Triggers

- if regulators raise safety concerns
- if uptake is weak

> *"Jag tycker det är ett litet plus igen."*

---

### ⛔ HEM — Hemnet | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

DNB Carnegie cut its recommendation, calling Hemnet an option; share down

#### Reasoning

This is the analyst's opinion, not the hosts'. The DNB Carnegie cut drove the share lower on the day.

> *"DNB Carnegie har ju sänkt rekommendationen och jag läser flashen att Hemnet liknar en option."*

---

### 🟡 NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Still volatile after study setbacks and losing to Lilly; now more of a dividend stock at ~4.4% yield

#### Reasoning

The guest waits to see whether the new strategy works and expects volatility, with the dividend as some support.

#### Sell Triggers

- if more studies fail
- if market share losses to Lilly continue

> *"Det har blivit lite av en utdelningsaktie snarare än tillväxtaktie nu."*

---
